schema: arm x symbol x timeframe x exit x window
floor: NONE - every cell with 5+ trades is reported; censuses are floor-free entirely
symbol_note: NQ and ES appear in the census only, as replicates of the MNQ/MES index complex. Every performance number is MES, MNQ, MGC, MCL measured separately; nothing measured on one symbol is claimed for another.
timeframe_note: 5m spans 27 days and 1m spans 3.5 days - censused, not backtested. Daily is inapplicable: the chain occurs 12-20 times in 7-10 years because overnight and session liquidity pools do not exist at that bar size.

multi_timeframe.verdict: higher-timeframe liquidity pools are worse (-0.199R vs -0.060R median, 8/8 cells negative) and starve the population to 9-17 trades per cell. Individual timeframes 5/15/30/60/240/1440 were censused separately and 15/60/240 backtested separately; no timeframe is exempt from the negative verdict.
